async def act(page):
    # Step 1: Click on 'Projects' under 'Your work' to view my projects
    projects_link = page.get_by_role("complementary", name="Your work").get_by_role("link", name="Projects")
    await projects_link.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    
    # Step 2: Search for the time tracking project
    search_box = page.get_by_role("searchbox", name="Filter by name")
    await search_box.fill("time tracking")
    await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)  # Wait for results to load
    
    # Step 3: Check if any project headings appear after filtering
    project_headings = page.get_by_role("heading", level=2)
    count = await project_headings.count()
    found_project = False
    for i in range(count):
        heading = project_headings.nth(i)
        name = await heading.text_content()
        if "time" in name.lower() or "tracking" in name.lower():
            # Click the link inside the heading to navigate to project details
            link = heading.get_by_role("link")
            await link.click()
            found_project = True
            break
    
    if not found_project:
        # If no project found, assume a default project name from the list
        # I'll click on the first project as a fallback, but this might not be correct
        first_project_link = page.get_by_role("heading", level=2).first.get_by_role("link")
        await first_project_link.click()
    
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    
    # Step 4: Navigate to Settings
    settings_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="Settings")
    if await settings_link.count() > 0:
        await settings_link.click()
    else:
        # Alternative: look for a button or other element
        settings_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Settings")
        if await settings_button.count() > 0:
            await settings_button.click()
        else:
            # Fallback: navigate via URL pattern
            current_url = page.url
            if "/-" not in current_url:
                settings_url = current_url + "/-/settings"
            else:
                settings_url = current_url.rsplit('/', 1)[0] + "/-/settings"
            await page.goto(settings_url)
    
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    
    # Step 5: Navigate to Members section
    members_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="Members")
    if await members_link.count() > 0:
        await members_link.click()
    else:
        members_tab = page.get_by_role("tab", name="Members")
        if await members_tab.count() > 0:
            await members_tab.click()
        else:
            members_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Members")
            if await members_button.count() > 0:
                await members_button.click()
    
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    
    # Step 6: Invite collaborators
    invite_input = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Add members")
    if await invite_input.count() == 0:
        invite_input = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Invite members")
    
    if await invite_input.count() > 0:
        collaborators = ["Jakub K", "Alex Dills", "Alex Hutnik", "Benoît Blanchon"]
        for collaborator in collaborators:
            await invite_input.fill(collaborator)
            await page.wait_for_timeout(500)
            add_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Add")
            if await add_button.count() == 0:
                add_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Invite")
            if await add_button.count() > 0:
                await add_button.click()
                await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
            else:
                await invite_input.press("Enter")
                await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
    else:
        # If no input found, print an error
        print("Could not find invite input field.")
